protocol.targets: one cart or purchase event per user on the day, 30000 users
protocol.batch: ALS top 50 with scores (rec:batch), Item-kNN top 50 (sim:item), pop:global, from the events before the day

speed.sim:cooc: session co-occurrence, last 10 distinct products, from the events before the day
speed.user:recent: 20 newest events before the target, if the newest is under 24 h old
speed.user:bought: products bought before the target, removed from every list
speed.rec:rt: common.scoring.propagate through the similarity, decayed to the target time, top 50
speed.+self: the same similarity plus sim(i, i) = 1 for the user:recent products, so rec:rt also holds the products just viewed

protocol.merge: common.scoring.merge_scores (min-max per source, alpha * batch + (1 - alpha) * rt), completed with pop:global
protocol.selection: best ndcg@10 on the validation day
